mapper.select:
select a.APPLY_ID , a.REQ_HEAD_ID , r.REFUND_ID , h.REQ_HEAD_NO, h.ORG_BU_NAME, h.ORG_NAME, h.PROJECT_NAME, a.DEPOSIT_REFUND_STATUS, h.PUBLIC_END_TIME, h.DEPOSIT_AMOUNT intentionReceivable, h.RESPONSIBILITY_USER_NAME, a.VENDOR_CODE, a.VENDOR_NAME aVendorName, a.VENDOR_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME payerName, a.VENDOR_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME refundSupplierName, a.TRANS_TIME, h.DEPOSIT_AMOUNT paymentAmount, a.VENDOR_BANK_NAME, a.VENDOR_BANK_NUMBER, a.VENDOR_BANK_ACCOUNT, a.APPLY_HANDLE_TYPE, a.APPLY_HANDLE_REASON, i.VENDOR_NAME iVendorName, i.PRICE, i.CREATION_DATE, i.STATUS, r.REFUND_BANK_NUMBER, r.REFUND_BANK_NAME, r.REFUND_BANK_ACCOUNT, r.REFUND_AMOUNT, r.REFUND_TIME, r.REFUND_REASON, h.STATUS hStatus, i.STATUS iStatus, i.INVOICE_TYPE from scc_npm_sou_req_head h left join scc_npm_sou_req_apply a on h.REQ_HEAD_ID = a.REQ_HEAD_ID left join scc_npm_sou_intention_deposit_invoice i on h.REQ_HEAD_ID =i.REQ_HEAD_ID and i.INVOICE_TYPE = 'INVOICE' and i.APPLY_ID=a.APPLY_ID
and i.INVOICE_ID in ( select temp1.INVOICE_ID from ( select ii.INVOICE_ID,ii.APPLY_ID,ii.INVOICE_TYPE,ii.CREATION_DATE from scc_npm_sou_intention_deposit_invoice ii where ii.INVOICE_TYPE = 'INVOICE' ORDER BY ii.INVOICE_ID DESC LIMIT 10000000 ) temp1 where temp1.INVOICE_ID = ( select Max(temp2.INVOICE_ID) from scc_npm_sou_intention_deposit_invoice temp2 where temp2.APPLY_ID=temp1.APPLY_ID group by temp2.APPLY_ID ) group by temp1.APPLY_ID )
left join scc_npm_sou_intention_deposit_refund r on h.REQ_HEAD_ID =r.REQ_HEAD_ID and a.APPLY_ID =r.APPLY_ID and r.REFUND_ID in ( select temp.REFUND_ID from ( select rr.REFUND_ID,rr.APPLY_ID from scc_npm_sou_intention_deposit_refund rr order by rr.REFUND_ID desc limit 10000000 )temp group by temp.APPLY_ID ) where 1=1
AND h.REQ_HEAD_NO LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{reqHeadNo}),'%')
AND h.ORG_BU_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{orgBuName}),'%')
AND h.ORG_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{orgName}),'%')
AND h.PROJECT_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{projectName}),'%')
and convert(h.PUBLIC_END_TIME,char) like concat(concat('%',#{publicEndTime}),'%')
AND h.DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = #{intentionReceivable}
AND h.DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = #{paymentAmount}
AND h.RESPONSIBILITY_USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{responsibilityUserName}),'%')
AND a.VENDOR_CODE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{vendorCode}),'%')
AND a.VENDOR_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{aVendorName}),'%')
AND a.VENDOR_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{payerName}),'%')
AND a.VENDOR_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{refundSupplierName}),'%')
and convert(a.TRANS_TIME,char) like concat(concat('%',#{transTime}),'%')
AND a.VENDOR_BANK_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{vendorBankAccount}),'%')
AND a.VENDOR_BANK_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{vendorBankNumber}),'%')
AND a.VENDOR_BANK_ACCOUNT LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{vendorBankAccount}),'%')
AND a.APPLY_HANDLE_TYPE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{applyHandleType}),'%')
AND a.APPLY_HANDLE_REASON LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{applyHandleReason}),'%')
AND i.VENDOR_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{iVendorName}),'%')
and convert(i.CREATION_DATE,char) like concat(concat('%',#{creationDate}),'%')
and( i.STATUS = 'INVOICED' or i.STATUS = 'INVOICING' or i.STATUS = 'FAIL_INVOICED')
and i.STATUS is null
AND r.REFUND_BANK_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{refundBankNumber}),'%')
AND r.REFUND_BANK_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{refundBankName}),'%')
AND r.REFUND_BANK_ACCOUNT LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{refundBankAccount}),'%')
AND r.REFUND_AMOUNT LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{refundAmount}),'%')
AND r.REFUND_TIME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{refundTime}),'%')
AND h.STATUS LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{hStatus}),'%')
and a.DEPOSIT_REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUNDED'
and ( a.DEPOSIT_REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUND_FAILED' or a.DEPOSIT_REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUNDING')
and (a.DEPOSIT_REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUNDED' or a.DEPOSIT_REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUND_FAILED' or a.DEPOSIT_REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUNDING')
and a.DEPOSIT_REFUND_STATUS = 'NOT_REFUNDED'
and a.DEPOSIT_REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUNDED'
and ( a.DEPOSIT_REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUND_FAILED' or a.DEPOSIT_REFUND_STATUS = 'REFUNDING' or a.DEPOSIT_REFUND_STATUS = 'NOT_REFUNDED')
